French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Middle French sourcil, from Old French sourcil, sorcil, inherited from Latin supercilium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (France) IPA(key): /suʁ.sil/, /suʁ.si/
  • (Switzerland) IPA(key): /suʁ.sil/
  • (Belgium) IPA(key): /suʁ.si/, /suʁ.sil/
  • (Canada) IPA(key): /suʁ.si/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Paris)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

sourcil m (plural sourcils)

  1. eyebrow

Derived terms

[edit]
  • froncer les sourcils

Related terms

[edit]
  • cil

Further reading

[edit]
  • “sourcil”, in Trésor de la langue française informatisé [Digitized Treasury of the French Language], 2012
